title: Check-in catch-up
summary: Generate questions for selected journal dates, upcoming event planning, and past-event follow-up. Ask one at a time and retain the exact selection, source-linked resolution, comments and deferral.

create.note: Generation reconciles a bounded selected source scope rather than accepting model-authored question rows.

batch.reason: One response changes one source-linked question using its optimistic version.

delete.reason: Generated questions are reconciled with their source and retained as resolved or deferred workflow history rather than manually deleted.
